instructions: VectorCraft is a professional vector illustration app. Coordinates are points in document space (y down, origin at the first artboard's top-left; a new document is 612×792). Draw with draw_shape / draw_path, change colours with set_paint, look with screenshot and inspect_document. Every menu action is a command: find it with list_commands and run it with run_command. New objects become the selection, and most commands act on the selection (or on explicit `ids`). Backend: remote 127.0.0.1:7979.

tools.description: List VectorCraft commands (id, label, menu path, shortcut, parameter description, enabled state). Every editing action is a command; run any of them with run_command. Coordinates are points in document space, y down, origin at the first artboard's top-left.

enabledOnly.description: Only commands that can run right now

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against id, label and menu path (e.g. "align", "Object")

tools.name: list_commands
tools.title: List commands

tools.description: Execute any VectorCraft command by id with JSON params (see list_commands for ids and params). Examples: {"command":"object.group"}, {"command":"object.align","params":{"align":"left"}}, {"command":"file.new","params":{"width":800,"height":600}}. Returns the command's result (e.g. {id} for creation commands).

command.description: Command id, e.g. shape.rectangle, object.group, paint.setFill

tools.name: run_command
tools.title: Run command

tools.description: Summary of the active document: artboards, layer tree (ids, names, kinds, bounds, fill/stroke), selection, undo history, current tool and default paint.

tools.description: UI state of the running desktop app: tool and options, panels, dialogs, view (zoom/center), window, documents, perf. Desktop app only.

tools.description: Switch the active tool (as clicking it in the Tools panel). Ids: selection, directSelection, groupSelection, pen, rectangle, roundedRectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, lineSegment, …

tools.title: Select tool

tools.description: Drive the active tool with mouse events in document coordinates, exactly like the mouse would (e.g. a rectangle drag: down at (100,100), drag to (200,150), up at (200,150)). Optionally selects `tool` first.

holdMs.description: Milliseconds the pointer then holds still, button down (0..60000): Twirl, Pucker and Bloat keep applying

mods.description: Modifier keys held (cmd = Command on macOS / Ctrl elsewhere; alt = Option)

pressure.description: Pen pressure 0..1 (default 1): the Liquify tools' intensity with Use Pressure Pen on

mods.description: Modifier keys held (cmd = Command on macOS / Ctrl elsewhere; alt = Option)

tool.description: Optional tool to select before the gesture

tools.name: pointer_gesture
tools.title: Pointer gesture

tools.description: Create a path from points ([[x,y],…] or [{x,y,in?:[x,y],out?:[x,y]},…] with Bézier handles) or SVG path data `d`, then apply optional paint. Returns the new object id.

d.description: SVG path data (alternative to points), e.g. "M0 0 L100 0 L50 80 Z"

fill.description: Fill: "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

points.description: Anchors: [x,y] pairs or {x, y, in?, out?, smooth?} objects

stroke.description: Stroke: "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

tools.name: draw_path
tools.title: Draw path

tools.description: Create a live shape and apply optional paint. rectangle/ellipse: x, y, width, height (rectangle: radius = corner radius). polygon: cx, cy, radius, sides. star: cx, cy, radius1, radius2, points. line: x1, y1, x2, y2. Returns the new object id.

fill.description: Fill: "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

stroke.description: Stroke: "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

tools.name: draw_shape
tools.title: Draw shape

tools.description: Set fill, stroke and/or stroke weight on the selection (or `ids`) and as the default for new art.

fill.description: Fill: "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

stroke.description: Stroke: "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

tools.name: set_paint
tools.title: Set paint

tools.description: Send a key press with modifiers, e.g. {key:"Z", mods:{cmd:true}} (undo), {key:"Escape"}, {key:"Enter"}. In the desktop app it goes through the real keyboard path; headless, it runs the command or tool bound to that shortcut.

key.description: Key name: A–Z, 0–9, Enter, Escape, Delete, Backspace, Tab, Space, Left/Right/Up/Down, [ ]…

mods.description: Modifier keys held (cmd = Command on macOS / Ctrl elsewhere; alt = Option)

tools.name: press_key
tools.title: Press key

tools.description: Type text into the focused widget (text tool, dialog field). Desktop app only.
tools.name: type_text
tools.title: Type text

tools.description: Invoke a menu item by its command id (same ids as list_commands, including UI-only commands like view.zoomIn or window.* in the desktop app).
tools.name: invoke_menu
tools.title: Invoke menu

tools.description: Open a panel in the desktop app's dock (e.g. Layers, Swatches, Stroke, Align, Pathfinder, Transform). Desktop app only.
tools.name: open_panel
tools.title: Open panel

tools.description: Render the active artboard to PNG and return it as an image (optionally also saving it to `path`). With window:true (desktop app only) captures the whole app window instead.

window.description: Capture the app window (desktop app only)

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot

tools.description: Open a file as a new, active document: .vectorcraft, .drawcraft, .svg, .svgz, .pdf, .ai, .ait, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp, .tif, .tiff, .bmp, .vctemplate, .dxf, .emf, .wmf, .eps (see run_command document.formats). Templates (.ait, native templates) open as a new untitled document.
tools.name: open_file
tools.title: Open file

tools.description: Save the active document in the native .vectorcraft format.
tools.name: save_file
tools.title: Save file

tools.description: Export the active document with the engine's document.export (the same bytes in the app and headless): svg (artboard viewBox), pdf (one page per artboard: all, or `artboard` / `range`), png/jpg/webp/gif/png8/tiff/bmp/tga/psd (one rendered artboard; png8 is an indexed .png; psd keeps the layers), txt (the stories, back to front) or vectorcraft (a native copy; the document keeps its path). `selection: true` exports only the selected objects, cropped to their bounds. Template layers are left out; live effects are kept (geometry baked, SVG filters for shadows/glows/blur). Without `path` the bytes come back as dataBase64.

artboard.description: 0-based artboard (default: the first; PDF default: all)

options.description: More format options, passed through (see run_command document.formats), e.g. {"quality": 80} for jpg

outlineText.description: SVG: text as outlines (viewable without the fonts)

range.description: 1-based artboards such as "1-3, 5" (PDF: one page each; other formats take one)

selection.description: Export only the selection, cropped to it

tools.name: export
tools.title: Export

tools.description: Create point type at (x, y) (the first baseline), area type when width/height are given, or type in/on an existing path (`path` id + `mode` area|onPath; `pathEffect` rainbow|skew|3dRibbon|stairStep|gravity). Returns the text object id.

color.description: Text colour (#rrggbb): "#rrggbb", "none", [r,g,b] (0..1), {"c","m","y","k"}, {"gray"}, or a full paint.setFill params object ({"gradient":…} / {"swatch":name})

path.description: Existing path id to flow the text in (area) or along (onPath)

tools.name: add_text
tools.title: Add text

tools.description: Append a live effect (Effect menu) to the selection or `ids`. Omit `effect` to get the catalogue (ids, parameters, defaults). Examples: stylize.dropShadow {x, y, blur, opacity}, distort.roughen, warp.arc {bend}, path.offsetPath {offset}, pathfinder.add (on groups), blur.gaussian {radius}.

params.description: Effect parameters; missing keys take the dialog defaults

tools.name: apply_effect
tools.title: Apply live effect

tools.description: Combine the selected (or `ids`) objects destructively, back to front: unite, minusFront, intersect, exclude, divide, trim, merge, crop, outline, minusBack. For a non-destructive version apply the pathfinder.* effect to a group.
tools.name: pathfinder
tools.title: Pathfinder

tools.description: Move, rotate, scale, reflect or shear the selection (or `ids`); several may be combined and run in that order. Angles in degrees (counter-clockwise), scale in %. `origin` [x,y] defaults to the selection centre; `copy` transforms a copy.
tools.name: transform
tools.title: Transform

tools.description: Create a graph (graph tools) in the plot rectangle. Data as `csv` (first row: empty cell then series names; then one row per category: label, values…) or `series`/`categories`/`rows`. Edit later with run_command graph.setData / graph.setType.
tools.name: create_graph
tools.title: Create graph

tools.description: Make the selected (or `ids`) objects wrap objects: area type below them in the same layer flows around them (offset in pt, invert = flow inside). `release: true` removes the wrap.

offset.description: Gap between text and object (default 6 pt)

tools.name: text_wrap
tools.title: Text wrap

tools.description: Undo the last change (Edit → Undo).
tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo

tools.description: Redo the last undone change (Edit → Redo).
